title: Preserve non-mutating skipped generated-artifact refresh decisions

phases.objective: Preserve a read-only request evaluator outcome of skipped as a successful non-dispatch decision instead of converting the absent generated-artifact-refresh label into a blocked writer failure.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted generated-artifact refresh request evaluator and workflow-run dispatcher
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A successful read-only request artifact with outcome skipped because the open pull request does not carry the generated-artifact-refresh label
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The trusted dispatcher publishes canonical skipped evidence bound to the exact pull request and head SHA, requests no writer run, performs no repository mutation, and completes successfully.
steps: Download the exact run-bound request artifact and validate its contract, pull request number, exact head SHA, and source run ID.
Recognize request outcome skipped before protected-branch, pull-request, checkout, or writer-dispatch processing.
Emit mad4b.governed-generated-artifact-refresh-dispatch.v1 with outcome skipped and the original request reason.
Load the trusted publisher from main, upload structured evidence, and publish the exact-head canonical decision.
Enforce skipped as a successful terminal decision without invoking the registered generated-artifact writer.
assertions: A skipped request is not reclassified as blocked.
The original skip reason is preserved in canonical dispatcher evidence.
Skipped handling terminates before pull-request revalidation and writer dispatch.
No workflow_dispatch POST, repository content write, protected-ref mutation, or force push occurs on the skipped path.
Blocked malformed or stale requests remain fail-closed, while eligible labeled requests retain the existing writer-dispatch path.
Structured evidence remains Job-log independent and declares secrets_included=false.

phases.objective: Observe one unlabeled ready-for-review pull request produce a skipped request artifact and a successful canonical dispatcher decision without a delegated writer run.
Continue rejecting invalid contracts, stale source runs, moved heads, protected branches, and malformed identities while preserving only authenticated skipped requests.
The decision bridge performs no provider or deployment canary.
The skipped path performs no Production, deployment, provider, database, or protected-ref mutation.
